description: Branch R-PRESERVE-1 II-06 (public side) on an ACCDB. T(ID, A) carries two table properties created through CreateProperty, Description and an unknown one, CalcDbUnknown; U(ID, B) carries none. Eight saved queries are created one element apart: Q1 SELECT * FROM T; Q2 with a WHERE; Q3 a join of T and U; Q4 over U only; Q5 an UPDATE of T; Q6 with ORDER BY; Q7 DISTINCT; Q8 an aggregate. Each query's Properties (Name, Type, Value) are listed. Asks which queries list T's table properties among their own, which earlier showed Q-over-T lists and join and action queries did not, and what decides it (single table? SELECT list? ORDER BY? aggregate?).
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
